title: Stored null matter carried from Synchrony Hub to the Central Nexus bid (2 jumps)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-16 23:13 UTC (orders.log ENT-019: sell what your own ships store above the reserve). Null matter is in no target of game/reserve.tsv. Miners store 350 null matter at Synchrony Hub (28 pilots, the most 58) and 329 at Node Beta (the storage book, 23:12 UTC), gathered beside iron; Central Nexus is the one station that bids for it: 221 cr x 10 at its best price, 106 in all levels (data/market, 23:03 UTC). A test: one ship; the bid's depth, not our stock, is the limit (the fleet holds 2,759). The rest of a load is stored at Central Nexus.
